decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already records the panel-button, slide-switch, reset, touch-input, and BOOT-button mappings; no additional update or removal is required.
A complete same-message MODIFY already records all GPIO assignments stated for J_BTN3, J_BTN4, J_SW, J_TOUCH, and J_TOUCH2.
The connector and GPIO mapping does not change the standalone USB-power source, activation condition, current rating, or powered 3.3V scope.
The panel-connector mapping does not alter the requirement for local decoupling capacitors.
The mapping does not change the INA219 monitor or the 3.3V rail it measures.
The mapped panel controls and touch inputs do not change the addressable LEDs' supply, switching, or level-shifting behavior.
The source decision does not change the 3.3V power sources, OR-ing method, diode requirement, or source-selection behavior.
The panel-connector mapping does not affect the I2C series resistors, their placement, or their population policy.
The source does not discuss the charge-status LED chain, GPIO13, J_LED_CHG, or associated resistor and population settings.
The listed panel connectors are distinct from the interboard power and signal connectors, whose types, signals, and matching-order requirement remain unchanged.
The main-board panel mapping does not change the AXP2101 VMID/VSYS topology, battery input range, or downstream power path.
The panel-control connector mapping does not alter the power-board battery connector, pin functions, placement, voltage range, or AXP2101 destination.
